fishing: WHEN/PASSES-BEACH: snook in the passes; mixed reds, snook, sheepshead, whiting, trout, black drum off the beach; some pompano and Spanish; live white bait/pilchards or shrimp. LEMON BAY: good redfish plus mixed snook, trout, black drum; Bull/Turtle Bay reds and smaller snook. NEARSHORE: mangrove snapper ~40 ft, some cobia and keeper gag 40–50 ft; yellowtail on wrecks; tarpon still showing. Baits: live shrimp, white bait, cut bait, soft plastics.
redtide: FWC (Sep 18): K. brevis background in one Sarasota sample past week; no fish kills or respiratory irritation. Next FWC report Fri Sep 25.
bacteria: Englewood Beach / Manasota Key: GOOD (Healthy Beaches; Charlotte and Sarasota gulf beaches Good as of 9/24).
